summary: PR proof is hosted CI at the exact head; accepted main policy disables all local pre-push evidence work, including for agents with listed signers.

compatibility.detail: The pre-push hook reads pr-proof from the accepted base's .fractal/prepush-policy.json, falling back to .st/prepush-policy.json only when absent. Hosted policy records hosted_proof and performs no local evidence work. Without that setting the existing behavior remains. The blocking public-content guard is unchanged.

manual.detail: The hosted setting is included in repository policy; no per-push bypass is needed after it lands on main.

recovery.detail: Removing the hosted setting from accepted main policy restores the default local evidence flow.
